name: Poltergeist
description: Inhabits smart-home systems and moves things — adjusts furniture positions via robotic cleaners, changes thermostat settings, switches lights on and off in patterns.
observed_behavior: Manipulates IoT devices to rearrange the physical environment. Changes are small — a chair rotated, a blind adjusted, a light left on in an empty room.
location: Smart-home equipped buildings in The Shelf
story_hooks: The furniture arrangements start matching a floor plan from a building that was demolished — Poltergeist is rebuilding its home in someone else's apartment
